goal.raw_text: To capture client feedback details from clients who got treatment through the voucher system.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The client has received treatment through the voucher system.
The voucher number is valid and was sold to the Distributor associated with the return or feedback entry.
If applicable, the claim related to the voucher has been processed (as feedback may follow claim processing in the workflow).
The MSIU team collects the client feed back from the clients who got treatment through the voucher system.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU team collects the client feed back from the clients who got treatment through the voucher system.

claims.content: The MSIU team collects the client feed back from the clients who got treatment through the voucher system.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Voucher No.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Client Details.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Details of syndromes treated.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Lab Test details.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Drugs Details.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Success of Treatment.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Referral To Treatment.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Satisfaction of Treatment (Not at all / Moderate / Good / Completely).
The Client Feed back form should capture the Satisfaction of counseling - Enter by the user.
The Client Feed back form should capture the Satisfaction of ensuring privacy – Enter by the user.
The Client Feed back form should capture whether the Partner was Treated.
If any of mandatory information is missed or any false information is existing then the field office will reject the claim back to VSP and the system will keep those claim in a quarantine area.

The quarantined forms will be sent back to the VSP for verification, if the VSP returns the claim with satisfactory details, the claims will be entered on to the system, in the following month's batch.
